tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards. Text on it: ink, ink-2.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and forms. Text on it: ink, ink-2, brand-ink.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Field fills, chip fills and quiet panels inside a surface. Text on it: ink, ink-2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and outlined buttons (3:1 against surface and surface-2 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, helper text on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons, selected chips, the logo mark and focus rings. Atlantic teal. Text on it: on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of brand surfaces.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on brand and brand-hover.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and links on bg, surface and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected rows, info callouts and secondary buttons. Text on it: brand-ink, ink.

tokens.name: basalt
tokens.usage: Hero panels and the balance-card style blocks, named for Teide basalt. Text on it: on-basalt.

tokens.name: on-basalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on basalt.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Highlight: one accent per screen, e.g. a streak count or a new badge. Text on it: on-sun. Never body text.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sun.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface and good-soft. Always paired with the word or a check icon.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and banner background.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface and warn-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and banner background (for example a post waiting on a retry).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on surface and bad-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Error badge, banner and field-error background.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and wordmark only. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles and big numbers on basalt panels.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a display heading.
styles.sample: Tell us what you want to promote. We write it, draw it and post it.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, inputs and buttons. Never smaller on mobile inputs.
styles.sample: Your first post goes live tomorrow at 10:00.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Prices, counts, hashtags, tokens and timestamps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field; tight list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on mobile; card inner padding on small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of a landing section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges with text, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, banners, media inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and forms.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels on basalt.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and the language switch. Every button is a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on bg. Use once per layer, never on nested cards.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, sheets and toasts.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any tappable control on mobile.

tokens.name: tap-lg
tokens.usage: Primary submit button on sign-up and portal forms.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.
